name: cron-check-mcp
description: Cron expressions checked instead of guessed: a plain-English explanation, validation with the gotchas that bite (day-of-month OR day-of-week, steps that do not divide evenly, dates that never come), the next run times in any time zone with daylight-saving effects noted, and conversion between Unix cron, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, AWS EventBridge, Quartz and Spring. Offline, no key.

dependencyReasons.cronstrue: Plain-English descriptions of cron expressions in every dialect (seconds, years, L, W, #), used by four million installs a week; writing and testing another describer would repeat it.
